improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the product value and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the free searches mention creates urgency without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: This copy immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant), who it's for (trade and business professionals), and the core benefits (instant answers, voice chat, professional support). The subheading removes friction by highlighting the free trial without payment commitment, which increases conversion by lowering the barrier to entry. The name 'Gideon' is introduced upfront to build brand recognition.

improvements.suggestion:
**Q: What happens after my three free searches?**

A: After your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing unlimited AI-powered trade and business support. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30% with an annual plan. As a member, you unlock unlimited queries, voice chat, and a dedicated workspace built for professionals.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the conversion funnel—what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition from free trial to paid membership and reinforcing value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), it reduces uncertainty and builds trust, making visitors more likely to convert.
